description: Agent Purchases: submit the buyer’s own record of paid calls, each with what was ordered, the provider and endpoint, the quoted amount, the amount paid, the asset, network and destination paid, the settlement reference, the receipt held, what was kept of the result (stored, a summary, only a status or nothing), the result status and the time. The signed report totals what the ledger shows was paid by currency, names every field missing from every record, with missing amounts, destinations, results and receipts first, and says for each invisible failure (price drift between quote and charge, a call charged twice, a success status carrying the wrong result, money owed back with no proof to claim it) how many records can detect it and which cannot. Approval records are wever_approval-record-check, one workflow run’s records are wever_run-record-check and one job’s payments matched to receipts are wever_job-receipt-pack, and the boutique Agent Purchase API’s own intent and order state is wever_purchase-status. Verdict failures_undetectable, record_gaps or reconstructable. POST /api/purchase-record-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-purchases-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-purchases/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

records.description: The buyer’s own record of paid calls.

ordered.description: What was ordered, such as the call and its parameters.

quoted.description: The amount quoted before the call.

receipt.description: The receipt held, by id or location.

result.description: What was kept of the result.
